d7c96daab35e1af99f4abf39fac256296487b4b8.summary: Jamf Threat Labs (published 3 September 2026) describes a cluster of 14 trojanized macOS disk images and installer packages impersonating known Mac apps, tied to the Contagious Interview activity described as attributed to the DPRK. The apps are unsigned and need quarantine removal. They fetch a chain of shell scripts that installs Node.js and the OtterCookie malware, which provides remote access, credential theft, file scanning and clipboard clipping. The report says the samples do not execute by default, which may mean active testing or early development.

d7cdfea5fcfe8d01de3bc9033260e7863aa38c1f.summary: Accenture iDefense 2019 Cyber Threatscape Report: an overview of 2019 threat trends in five areas. It covers geopolitics and disinformation (social media, AI and 5G concerns, hacktivism used as cover), cybercrime moving to close-knit syndicates and sales of network access, ransomware with hybrid motives, supply chain compromise, and CPU side-channel flaws affecting cloud infrastructure. Groups named include SNAKEMACKEREL, WINTERFLOUNDER, FIN7, Cobalt Group, Contract Crew, Nikolay and GandCrab.
